hero.title: Sakura Moon
hero.taglineLight: A sakura garden where cosy games bloom
hero.description: A small indie studio crafting warm, strategic, beautifully illustrated games — inspired by Japanese aesthetics and the belief that small things made carefully are the best things.

care.title: Made with Care
care.body: Every game is small, intentional, and crafted slowly — like pottery, made with full attention to every detail.

cosy.title: Cosy but Strategic
cosy.body: Warm aesthetics with real depth underneath. Beautiful to look at. Genuinely challenging to master.

everyone.title: For Everyone
everyone.body: Games for players who like to think, feel, and take their time. No rushing. Just good things worth returning to.

newsletter.title: Join the Community
newsletter.body: Be the first to know about FARMED.COM updates, release dates, and cosy studio news.
newsletter.disclaimer: No spam. Unsubscribe anytime. We promise.
newsletter.success: You're in! 🌸 We'll keep you posted.

kuro.title: Meet Kuro
kuro.body: The black cat who watches from the moon. He appears in every game we make — curious, quiet, and always present.
kuro.note: He has opinions about the Inspector.

games.title: What we're making
games.subtitle: Small games. Made carefully. Worth your time.

farmed.title: FARMED.COM
farmed.subtitle: Sudoku Farm Roguelike
farmed.tagline: Four seasons. Two farmers. One drone. A man with a clipboard.
farmed.description: An elderly farming couple lose their farm to a storm overnight. Their grandson shows them FARMED.COM. She asks practical questions. He asks what a drone is.
farmed.description2: Every map node is a customer order. Every order is a Sudoku puzzle. Solve the grid, harvest the right crops, fulfil the delivery. Seasons change. The board gets harder. At the end of Winter, a man with a clipboard arrives. He is not unkind. He is the standard.
farmed.gridCaption: Sudoku rules · No numbers, only crops

features.title: Crop Sudoku
features.body: 9 seasonal crops replace 1–9. No numbers ever appear on the board.

features.title: Roguelike Map
features.body: Procedural node map like Slay the Spire. Choose your path through each season.

features.title: The Drone
features.body: Drone Blue (#3A78B4) collects every delivery. Every review changes your store rating.

features.title: The Farm Bell
features.body: A 30-second clock evaluates the board. Wrong crops damage your Soil Life.

features.title: Farm Tools
features.body: Unlock tools each run that modify how you play. No two runs are the same.

features.title: The Inspector
features.body: The true final boss. He appears after Winter. He has a clipboard. He is thorough.

comingSoon.title: More games coming
comingSoon.body: FARMED.COM is just the beginning. Sakura Moon Atelier will keep crafting small, cosy, strategic games with care.

about.title: Who we are
about.subtitle: A studio built in small moments, late evenings, and endless cups of coffee.

studio.title: The Studio
studio.body1: Sakura Moon Atelier is a micro indie game studio — currently a one-person operation, with Kuro providing moral support and occasional quality assurance.
studio.body2: We make cosy, strategic games with beautiful illustrations and real depth. Inspired by Japanese aesthetics, Studio Ghibli's warmth, and the roguelike games that refuse to let you go.
studio.body3: The name comes from the two things that feel most like home: sakura blossoms in spring, and the quiet of a moonlit night.

founder.name: Ana
founder.role: Engineer · Cat Lover · Magic Enthusiast · Builder of Cosy Worlds
founder.bio1: By day, a software engineer and iOS framework architect. By night, the person responsible for FARMED.COM, the Sudoku crop rotation puzzle that probably shouldn't exist but absolutely should.
founder.bio2: Teaching Android development at ISEL by day, designing cosy roguelikes by night — always with a cup of coffee nearby and Kuro watching from somewhere slightly too close to the screen.

kuro.title: Kuro
kuro.role: Chief Quality Officer · Moon Watcher · Professional Distractor
kuro.bio: A small black cat with big opinions. Kuro appears in every game Sakura Moon Atelier makes. He was there when FARMED.COM was designed. He will be there at the Inspector's final judgment.
